glosses: To cleanse, as clothes, by treading upon them in water.

examples.text: Soak them [blankets, etc.], add to the water in which the linens were washed some soap, and also some of the preparation to produce a strong lather; rub or tramp them, then rinse and dry.

glosses: To scram; begone.

examples.text: She hesitated, “be off—tramp, march,” he exclaimed, in a tone which the poor girl dared not disobey. She left the room, and Edward followed her to the door.
Tramp, my lad. Bundle out of this, please, hand over hand, and double quick.

glosses: To shake or judder under hard acceleration or braking, referring to the movement of a vehicle's driving axle caused by the suspension not fully restraining it, leading to reduction in tire traction.
Clipping of trampoline, especially a very small one.
